title: Armor: Sleeves
description: Replicate the sleeve armor pieces from Blender-Procedural-Human in Ixdar DSL. Source: procedural_human/geo_node_groups/armor/sleeves.py. Key techniques: bi_rail_loft, pipes, cone primitives, noise texture displacement, extrude-mesh, mesh-to-curve. Use boundary_a/boundary_b from BiRailLoftNode for surface-following pipes.
definition-of-done: 1. sleeves.dsl compiles without errors. 2. Mesh comparison gate passes. 3. Visual comparison shows recognizable silhouette match.
testing-plan: 1. Export Blender reference OBJ. 2. Run validate-dsl to export generated OBJ. 3. Run mesh_distance() comparison. 4. Visual inspection.
